newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani rice export prices seen falling.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani rice export prices seen falling.

text.p: Pakistani rice export prices are likely to fall in the next trading week starting Saturday owing to low foreign demand and higher supplies amid new crop arrivals, dealers said on Thursday.
"There is no major buyer in the market," one dealer said, adding that importers might wait for prices to fall with the arrival of the new crop and then make deals at lower levels.

In the local market, prices of new crop rice were likely to remain mixed, the dealer said. Pakistan expects to have an exportable surplus of 1.5 million tonnes from the 1996/97 (July-June) compared to 1.36 million last year.
